verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships its core engine as an official SDK: NPM packages for all modules, tree-shakable ES6 modules, and full TypeScript/IntelliSense support, which is the primary way AI-native developers would programmatically build against it. Community feedback corroborates that the TypeScript integration works well in practice (e.g., React-BabylonJS). missing for 10: no evidence of multi-language SDKs beyond JS/TS, no independent API-stability audit or versioned SDK release notes, and no broader hands-on validation of AI-agent-style consumption of the SDK.
